title: 9x faster bit-word generator (110 s -> 12 s), byte-identical output (no new κ)
body:
Faster drop-in `paired_cube_bit_word.py`: `--p 12` in ~12 s instead of ~110 s (~9x, measured back to back). Pure Python, outputs byte-identical to the pinned original. No new κ.

The generator isn't on main yet, so this adds one self-contained package (`research/paired-cube-bit-fast/`, original pinned from #168 at 4a3c769, also carried unchanged by #178, #182, #189 and #198) and changes no existing file.

    python3 -B research/paired-cube-bit-fast/verify.py                 # ~12 s
    python3 -B research/paired-cube-bit-fast/verify.py --against-main  # ~1 min: regenerates the bit word main carries, must match byte for byte

Equivalence is checked by byte-identical regeneration of the default p=12 word, not proved.
